The '''Flesh Raider Bladewielder''' was a [[Flesh Raider]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A Flesh Raider with [[gray]] skin and [[white]] [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Bladewielder was part of a group sent to establish a base in the ruins of the ancient [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] temple-city [[Kaleth]] during the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] in [[3643 BBY]]. The Flesh Raider rose to a position of power after defeating the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Laotah]], who had attempted to investigate the Flesh Raider base. Earning the title by mortally wounding the Jedi and taking his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Bladewielder used the [[blue]]-bladed weapon in conjunction with [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] until the Flesh Raider was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], who had been [[Raid on the Forsaken Den|sent to eliminate]] the base.<ref name="Dark Temptations" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Flesh Raider Bladewielder appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]]. The Bladewielder appears in the Jedi Knight mission "Dark Temptations" on Tython, as the enemy boss within the level. The item description for Laotah's lightsaber refers to the enemy as a "Flesh Raider firewielder," though that description was dropped in favor of "Bladewielder" for the NPC's name.<ref name="Dark Temptations" />
